1988‐09‐16: Madison Square Garden, New York, NY, USA

_note: Stops, open_year, chart_view and year_questions are stand-ins for the model's choices; every other fact is the library's.

stops.label: The debut
stops.why: First time out, opening the show five months before the studio album.

stops.label: Hartford, the version of record
stops.why: Released on its own as To Terrapin. The spring 1977 arrangement at full strength.

stops.label: At the pyramids
stops.why: Played at the foot of the Great Pyramid, coming out of Space.

stops.label: Charlie Miller's pick
stops.why: The 1979 show Charlie Miller singles out, and the one from the visitor's first question.

stops.label: New Year's, inside Playin'
stops.why: Tucked into the middle of Playing in the Band on New Year's Eve.

stops.label: With Clarence Clemons
stops.why: Clemons sits in on sax and the song stretches to almost 23 minutes.

stops.label: The longest
stops.why: Over 25 minutes in Boston, the longest Terrapin on record.

stops.label: The last
stops.why: The final Terrapin, at Soldier Field the night before the band's last show.
